infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: FaceSecrets uses the camera so you can take a portrait for your private reflection report. The photo is uploaded only after you agree, and it is deleted after processing.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: FaceSecrets lets you choose one portrait from your library for your private reflection report. The photo is deleted after processing.
